Figure 2:The training corpus combines 136K clips from eight sources.Each sector of the ring shows
one source, with the condition on the inner ring (the first frame for
WildWorld and OmniWorld) and the ground-truth frame of the same clip on
the outer ring. The panels give the scale and construction steps of the
data, the clips of each source by input combination, the time of day and
scenes named in the captions, and the most frequent words of the
captions across all training clips.

Table 1:Comparison with existing methods.Gemini Elo ratings
for the four judge questions and the automatic score (Auto.) on both test
sets. The causal variant is rated only against ours. Methods that lose
every comparison on a question share one rating. Bold and underlined
italics mark the best and second-best values.

a normal map, and a wireframe. The remaining columns show our generated
appearances at the same time.

Figure 6:Visual comparison with other methods.Top to bottom: structural condition, results from other works, and ours.

Magpie, and CWM, with frames synchronized within each example.

Figure 7:A gallery of structure-conditioned renderings.Each image comes from a different case, spanning human motion, everyday scenes,
